purpose: Resume-safe, storage-light constructive screen of every delete-two/add-three completion core from the pinned verified 42-vertex catalog.
partition_rule: Four balanced, disjoint, line-contiguous shards in catalog order; each line contains all 861 vertex pairs in lexicographic order.

encoding.variable_order: 40 A-core, 40 B-core, 40 C-core, AB, AC, BC
encoding.clauses: homogeneous core 4-sets with one new vertex, triples with two new vertices, and pairs with all three new vertices

compact_format.record_order: catalog line, deleted-left, deleted-right, all lexicographic
compact_format.fields: pair identity; UNSAT/LIMIT status; max depth; clause polarity and core substructure counts; nodes, branches, leaves, unit assignments, elapsed microseconds, record index
compact_format.sat_policy: SAT is never encoded as a compact negative/status record; the producer emits the raw model and stops the shard immediately.

worker_mode: four simultaneous persistent C++ processes, one exact contiguous 82-line shard each
resume_policy: Validate and reuse atomically promoted complete shards. Preserve any stale partial, invalid shard, or mismatched result under diagnostics without deletion. Refuse launch if existing retained bytes plus every missing complete shard plus the metadata allowance could exceed the hard output cap.
progress_policy: Emit progress at each completed catalog line and a distinct boundary record when each of the four shards is independently parsed and accepted.

status_policy.SAT: Stop all ordinary workers immediately, atomically preserve the raw model, reconstruct the 43-vertex graph, and require both exhaustive Python and independent C++ bitset verification before certification.
status_policy.UNSAT: Record OBSERVED_UNSAT_UNCHECKED with negative_certified=false and no proof. This is only a reproducible computational observation.
status_policy.ERROR: Stop the run, preserve diagnostics, and fail the exact coverage audit.

immutable_stop_rules: Do not launch on any pinned catalog, catalog audit, producer source, included solver source, binary, parser, runner, checker, Python executable, SAT verifier, command, partition, or output-path drift.
Do not launch a fresh run unless free disk is at least 2197483648 bytes, thereby retaining at least 2 GiB even if the full 50000000-byte hard cap is consumed.
Do not launch unless the exact ordinary retained-size projection is 16055840 bytes and no larger than the 50000000-byte hard cap.
Stop all workers by 10800 wall seconds, before retained output exceeds 50000000 bytes, or when free disk falls below 2147483648 bytes.
Stop ordinary work on the first SAT status for atomic raw-model preservation, reconstruction, and dual verification.
Stop and report incomplete on hash drift, shard/order mismatch, producer/parser disagreement, worker error, wall-cap breach, output-cap breach, or reserve breach.
UNSAT and LIMIT statuses are never certified negative outcomes in this screen.
scope_warning: Every outcome concerns one fixed induced 40-vertex catalog core. Negative observations imply no global order-43 nonexistence and change no Ramsey bound.
